analysis.summary: During the H2 FY26 earnings call, MaxVolt Energy management reported robust financial performance with significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by strong market demand and capacity expansion. The company highlighted strategic initiatives including the establishment of its dedicated recycling subsidiary MaxVolt ReEarth, expansion across multiple states and OEM partnerships, and scaling monthly battery production capacity. Management also addressed supply chain pressures, geopolitical impacts on raw material costs, and ongoing capex plans for their Aligarh lithium battery recycling and manufacturing facilities. MaxVolt Energy Industries Limited released its investor presentation for H2 FY26, reporting significant operational and financial growth across its lithium-ion battery manufacturing and ecosystem businesses. The company highlighted revenue of INR 29,676.5 lacs for FY26 and detailed ongoing expansions in manufacturing, R&D, and circular economy initiatives such as battery recycling.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are expecting a 50% to 60% or 70% growth in forward revenues.
guidance.quote: And in terms of the forward I can say the forward revenues, you will see a substantial growth, and we can say like a 50%, 60%, 70% growth you will see around.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are aiming to maintain sustainable profit margins.
guidance.quote: It's going to be a similar pattern we are expecting, we are trying to keep maintaining this profitability because that is our aim actually.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve a 5% market share in India's lithium recycling and battery pack manufacturing by FY2032.
guidance.quote: Targeting 5% share in India’s lithium recycling and battery pack manufacturing by FY2032.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 5% market share in India.
Maxvolt aims to capture around 5% of the annual Indian recycling opportunity by FY32.
guidance.quote: Within India, the recycling opportunity alone is estimated at $1.2 to $1.5 billion annually by 2030, and Maxvolt aims to capture around 5% of the market by FY32, contributing to over 12,000 tons of annual CO2 reduction through circular operations.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the e-scooter segment continued to be a cornerstone of the business, registering a robust growth of 147.6% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Delivering a revenue of INR217 crores, contributing 73.1% of total revenue and registering a robust growth of 147.6% year-on-year growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that the e-rickshaw segment emerged as the fastest-growing vertical with exponential growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our e-rickshaw segment has emerged to the fastest-growing vertical, delivering revenue of INR22 crores and contributing 7.4% of total revenue with exponential growth of 5,564.3%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the energy storage segment delivered revenue reflecting growing demand in sustainable energy storage solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Our energy storage, ESS segment delivered revenue of about INR21.4 crores, contributing 7.2% to total revenue that is registering a strong growth of 537.4%, reflecting growing demand in sustainable energy storage solutions.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the EV and energy storage market is experiencing strong demand.
demand_outlook.quote: During the first half of FY '26, we are proud to show that we have delivered a phenomenal performance with revenue, surging by 222.9% year-on-year to INR 130 crores, driven by strong demand, capacity expansion and operation excellence.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is high in the African market for retail segmentation.
demand_outlook.quote: And African market where we are working for that retail segmentation, where we are talking about some associate partner.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the total estimated project cost for the Aligarh plant is about INR282 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: That overall plant cost, estimated cost is the project cost is about INR282 crores and including construction, including machines, laboratory, pilot line, crushing plant, and the industrial scale what we are expecting and planning right now.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the machinery cost for the 1.5 gigawatt automatic line is about INR31 crores approximate.
capex_expansion.quote: That machine cost is about INR31 crores approximate.

capex_expansion.claim: The company set up a 55,000 sq. ft. new facility at Ghaziabad alongside its existing plant.
capex_expansion.quote: With an installed capacity of 600 -750 MWh (depending on product type) including a newly commissioned 55,000 sq. ft. facility alongside our existing Ghaziabad plant, we are steadily expanding production capacity and evaluating new sites for further scale.

capex_expansion.claim: A new 55,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility was commissioned in Ghaziabad during H1 FY26, doubling production capacity to 12,500 battery packs per month.
capex_expansion.quote: A key milestone in H1 FY '26 was the commissioning of a new 55,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Ghaziabad, which doubled our production capacity from 6,000 to 12,500 battery packs per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Land has been allotted by the UP MSME Department for the Aligarh recycling plant under Phase 1.
capex_expansion.quote: Under Phase-1, that is crushing and black mass generation, the land has been allotted by the UP MSME Department for our Aligarh recycling plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The initial capacity of the Aligarh recycling plant will be 7,800 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: This plant will commence operation in FY '26-'27, with an initial capacity of 7,800 metric tons per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 metal extraction and refining unit is targeted for FY28-29.
capex_expansion.quote: For Phase-2, metal extraction and refining was being developed in parallel, with an advanced extraction unit targeted for FY '28-'29, focused on recovering metals like nickel, cobalt, manganese and lithium.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported an EBITDA margin of 10.3% and a PAT margin of 6.9% for the second half of financial year 26.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA stood at INR17.2 crores, marking a year-on-year growth increase of 101% with an EBITDA margin of 10.3%. Profit after tax, our PAT came to an end at INR11.5 crores, reflecting year-on-year growth of 115% with a PAT margin of 6.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the expected EBITDA margin for the black mass shredding and separation plant is about 18% to 20%.
margins_costs.quote: So, in terms of EBITDA is about 18% to 20% approximate.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that gross margins for the retail market in electric vehicles are about 20%, 22%, 23% approximate.
margins_costs.quote: Specifically, if you are doing the retail market in the electric vehicle, including your two-wheeler and three-wheeler, that gross margins are about 20%, 22%, 23% approximate.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 stood at 14.2%.
The profit after tax margin for H1 FY26 was 9.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Our profit after tax, our PAT value, come in at INR 1,292 lakhs, reflecting year-on-year growth of about 171%, with the PAT margin of 9.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margins around 30% to 35% for the recycling operations.
margins_costs.quote: And in terms of just the roughly numbers, we will be doing around 30% to 35% of the margins in there.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that their monthly production capacity exceeds 14,000 plus batteries.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing infrastructure continues to scale through two production facilities with a monthly production capacity exceeding 14,000 plus batteries, while our service and reverse logistics network extends across more than 1,300 pin codes nationwide.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the current phase operationalized leads capacity to somewhere around 500 megawatt-hour, targeting around 2 gigawatt-hour when complete.
orders_capacity.quote: So, basically, the current phase that we have made operational it leads our capacity to somewhere around 500 megawatt-hour. Once the complete plant is operational, so the whole capacity is going to be around like 2 gigawatt-hour.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that they currently have an order book which is more than 150% of capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Surely, we already running we already have an order book, which is more than 150% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed production capacity is 600 - 750 MWh depending on the product type.
orders_capacity.quote: With an installed capacity of 600 -750 MWh (depending on product type) including a newly commissioned 55,000 sq. ft. facility alongside our existing Ghaziabad plant, we are steadily expanding production capacity and evaluating new sites for further scale.

orders_capacity.claim: The dealer and distributor network has expanded to 875+ partners.
The dealer-distributor network expanded from 620 to over 800 during the period.
orders_capacity.quote: Our dealer-distributor network expanded from 620 to over 800, and our OEM partnership grew from 22 to 26, reflecting the increased confidence of our customers and partners.

orders_capacity.claim: The company established a presence across 1,200 pin codes in India.
orders_capacity.quote: We have established a strong presence across 1,200 pin codes of India, steadily progressing towards full nation coverage.

orders_capacity.claim: Employee strength rose from 200 to over 320.
orders_capacity.quote: Our employees' strength also rose from 200 to 320 plus, supporting our expansion operations and innovation initiatives.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they are borrowing money from banks and taking working capital to secure the supply chain and enhance operations.
capital_allocation.quote: So that's why we are just borrowing this money from bank and we take the working capital form of working capital and that the average ROI I believe is going -- we are trying to reduce that the average ROI what we are getting from the bank side, which is about 8.15%, 8.9% approximate.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents stood at INR 2,636.6 lacs as of March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted there is a slight delay from the government regarding map approvals and registry processes for the Aligarh plant.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, there is a slight delay from the government itself. So, we are already aligned on it and we are working. So, we have already, once the registry gets done on January 8th.

risks_headwinds.claim: India faces challenges including a lack of domestic lithium, cobalt, and nickel reserves.
risks_headwinds.quote: Lacks domestic lithium, cobalt, nickel reserves.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Indian ecosystem faces capital, talent, and recycling infrastructure gaps.
risks_headwinds.quote: Faces capital, talent, and recycling infrastructure gaps.

risks_headwinds.claim: India currently accounts for less than 1% of global battery cell production.
Management noted that forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: The statements are not guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are hoping to start production in December '26 or maximum January '27.
management_commitments.quote: Hopefully, the coming new calendar year, in year '27, we are hoping to get the start production December and January, December '26 or maximum January '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Phase 2 of the battery pack manufacturing plant can be expected to be operational by October-November of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we -- so you can expect it to be operational by October-November of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a 5% share in India’s lithium recycling and battery pack manufacturing by FY2032.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting 5% share in India’s lithium recycling and battery pack manufacturing by FY2032.

management_commitments.claim: Construction of the Aligarh recycling plant is scheduled to begin by March 2026.
management_commitments.quote: With construction scheduled to begin by March 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The Aligarh recycling plant will commence operation in FY26-27.
management_commitments.quote: This plant will commence operation in FY '26-'27, with an initial capacity of 7,800 metric tons per annum.

management_commitments.claim: The advanced extraction unit for Phase 2 is targeted for FY28-29.
management_commitments.quote: For Phase-2, metal extraction and refining was being developed in parallel, with an advanced extraction unit targeted for FY '28-'29, focused on recovering metals like nickel, cobalt, manganese and lithium.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
